The Deadlock Protocol.Description: A power struggle within the Corpus elite has erupted. Seeking control, Nef Anyo looks to the past... to the very origins of the Corpus itself.
The Deadlock Protocol.Name: The Deadlock Protocol

Angels of the Zariman.Description: From depths beyond reason a Voice had spoken, and its echoes would not be denied. No longer fully concealed by the ever-shifting Void, the Zariman now rests between worlds. A haunting song resounds across the System. It is time for an overdue confrontation with the past...
Angels of the Zariman.Name: Angels of the Zariman

Vox Solaris.Description: Eudico would do anything to keep her people safe, but will she stand up to Nef Anyo?
Vox Solaris.Name: Vox Solaris

The Second Dream.Description: The Sentient Hunhow seeks to destroy the Tenno by exploiting long forgotten secrets.
The Second Dream.Name: The Second Dream

Howl of the Kubrow.Description: You are Tenno, you deserve a Kubrow by your side.
Howl of the Kubrow.Name: Howl of the Kubrow

Whispers in the Walls.Description: Loid has had strange dreams and desperately needs to show you something.
Whispers in the Walls.Name: Whispers in the Walls

Corpus Void Key.Description: Corpus Scouts are hiding in the Void. Use this key to find their ships and hunt them down!
Corpus Void Key.Name: Corpus Void Key

The Sacrifice.Description: A tortured vision sends the Operator on the hunt for a Warframe unlike any other.
The Sacrifice.Name: The Sacrifice

Mask of the Revenant.Description: The Unum chooses Nakak to receive a strange mask. A mask that leads to even stranger visions. What lost story does the Unum want to tell?
Mask of the Revenant.Name: Mask of the Revenant

The Limbo Theorem.Description:
The Limbo Theorem quest cannot be completed without an Archwing

Piece together the Limbo Theorem to uncover its source
The Limbo Theorem.Name: The Limbo Theorem

The Archwing.Description: The Balor Fomorians are coming but we are ready. Through your efforts we finally have a working Archwing prototype and I am sending you the blueprint. However, your task is not yet complete. You still must discover the component parts.
The Archwing.Name: The Archwing

Jordas Golem Assassinate.Description: Access this assassination mission by completing the Jordas Precept quest.
Jordas Golem Assassinate.Name: Jordas Golem Assassinate

A Man of Few Words.Description: Darvo needs your help again. Save one of his best contractors from Grineer execution.
A Man of Few Words.Name: A Man of Few Words

Call of the Tempestarii.Description: Void Storms gather in Corpus lanes... could a mysterious vessel somehow be the cause?
Call of the Tempestarii.Name: Call of the Tempestarii

Grendel Chassis Locator.Description: Reveals sites on Europa likely to contain Grendel part blueprints.
Grendel Chassis Locator.Name: Grendel Chassis Locator

Grendel Systems Locator.Description: Reveals sites on Europa likely to contain Grendel part blueprints.
Grendel Systems Locator.Name: Grendel Systems Locator

Abyssal Beacon.Description: The Syndicates need help finighing a doomed mission to recover Orokin Era Defixios froma a Galleon of Grineer raiders adrift in the Abyssal Zone, near Ceres. Defixios are known to contain Vainthorns.
Abyssal Beacon.Name: Abyssal Beacon

Jade Shadows.Description: Struggling to understand the oldest and deepest secret of his past, Stalker finds himself allied with sworn enemies on the troubling road towards uncovering the truth... and averting incalculable loss.
Jade Shadows.Name: Jade Shadows

Sands of Inaros.Description: Help Baro Ki'Teer raid an ancient Martian tomb for a mysterious treasure.
Sands of Inaros.Name: Sands of Inaros

The Jordas Precept.Description: Ordis is determined to help a fellow Cephalon overcome a ship wide infestation.
The Jordas Precept.Name: The Jordas Precept

Baro Void-Signal.Description:
Unlock a mission with this device.

Baro Ki'Teer can home in on Inaros Prime anywhere in the Void. Ideal for following the God King to riches!
Baro Void-Signal.Name: Baro Void-Signal

Grendel Neuroptics Locator.Description: Reveals sites on Europa likely to contain Grendel part blueprints.
Grendel Neuroptics Locator.Name: Grendel Neuroptics Locator

Saya's Vigil.Description: On the Plains of Eidolon a mystery has lain buried for years: one that will mend or destroy a heart, and open the door to a hidden past.
Saya's Vigil.Name: Saya's Vigil

The Glast Gambit.Description: Nef Anyo has stolen the children of the Mycona Colony and it is up to you to get them back. You must challenge Nef on The Index and beat him at his own game. But Tenno, beware, not all is as it seems.
The Glast Gambit.Name: The Glast Gambit

Once Awake.Description: Intercepted Grineer communications reveal that Grineer have been experimenting with some sort of bio weapon. You must investigate.
Once Awake.Name: Once Awake

Mutalist Alad V Assassinate (Sortie).Description: Put an end to Alad V and his Mutalist experiments
Mutalist Alad V Assassinate (Sortie).Name: Mutalist Alad V Assassinate (Sortie)

Simulacrum Access Key.Description:
Grants access to the Simulacrum.

In the Simulacrum you can face mimeographs of enemies you have fully researched with the Codex.
Simulacrum Access Key.Name: Simulacrum Access Key

The Silver Grove.Description: New Loka seeks help protecting a sacred forest from Grineer incursions, but are they ready to face the forest’s true nature?
The Silver Grove.Name: The Silver Grove

The Hex.Description: The desperate hunt for Albrecht Entrati has led the Drifter to the city of Höllvania on December 31st, 1999. Despite the Scaldra lockdown in the face of the Techrot menace, the citizens do their best to celebrate. But this has all happened before... and ended in disaster.
The Hex.Name: The Hex

Mutalist Alad V Assassinate.Description: Put an end to Alad V and his Mutalist experiments
Mutalist Alad V Assassinate.Name: Mutalist Alad V Assassinate

Stolen Dreams.Description: Find the thief Maroo and uncover the secrets of the Arcane Codices.
Stolen Dreams.Name: Stolen Dreams

Clan Key.Description: Unlocks access to your Clan's Dojo
Clan Key.Name: Clan Key

Vor's Prize.Description:
MY QUEENS -

You were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR
Vor's Prize.Name: Vor's Prize

Apostasy Prologue.Description: Inspect your personal quarters upon finishing the Chains of Harrow quest.
Apostasy Prologue.Name: Apostasy Prologue

The Old Peace.Description: Albrecht Entrati's trail leads beyond the Origin System. Only by delving into the past can the path ahead be made clear - but buried secrets can be deadly.
The Old Peace.Name: The Old Peace

The Teacher.Description: Corpus incursions into Grineer territory lead to showdown with a forgotten rival.
The Teacher.Name: The Teacher

The War Within.Description: A disturbance in the Somatic Link prompts the Lotus to send operatives back to the Tenno Reservoir.
The War Within.Name: The War Within

Awakening.Description:
The Tenno: monuments of an ancient warrior caste.

For generations you've slept, with no call to wake you.

Until now.
Awakening.Name: Awakening

Octavia's Anthem.Description: Build the Mandachord and find the cause of Cephalon Suda’s erratic behavior.
Octavia's Anthem.Name: Octavia's Anthem

The Lotus Eaters.Description: A strange call comes from beyond and must not go unanswered.
The Lotus Eaters.Name: The Lotus Eaters

Chains of Harrow.Description: A strange transmission leads deep into the dark world of Red Veil mysticism. What evils will be found there and what do they want?
Chains of Harrow.Name: Chains of Harrow

Chimera Prologue.Description: Investigate your personal quarters upon completion of The Sacrifice.
Chimera Prologue.Name: Chimera Prologue

Rising Tide.Description: To face a growing threat, a long dormant Cephalon calls on you to reconstruct an Orokin-era interceptor craft: the Railjack.
Rising Tide.Name: Rising Tide

Jade Shadows: Constellations.Description: When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequence of his own actions. The shadows of the future have come calling, and they are not alone.
Jade Shadows: Constellations.Name: Jade Shadows: Constellations

Heart of Deimos.Description: Deimos emerges in Martian orbit, completely overrun by the Infestation... yet among the writhing mass, a distress call comes over a most ancient carrier wave...
Heart of Deimos.Name: Heart of Deimos

Natah.Description: Strange drones have appeared in the Origin System, help the Lotus find out what they are and who sent them.
Natah.Name: Natah

The New War.Description:
The Sentient armada has emerged from the Veil Proxima in shocking numbers.

At their head, Natah, once the trusted guide 'Lotus', now seemingly in thrall to Ballas and her brother Erra.

Across worlds and space, the Tenno and their unlikely alliance launch a final assault to take the Sentient mothership... where Natah awaits.
The New War.Name: The New War

The Waverider.Description: When tragedy strikes, the Ventkids search for hope in a long-lost story.
The Waverider.Name: The Waverider

Veilbreaker.Description: Daughter Entrati gets more than she bargained for when she enlists the Tenno to investigate a call for reinforcements aboard a Narmer Murex.
Veilbreaker.Name: Veilbreaker

Enter Nihil's Oubliette.Description: Use this key to enter Nihil's Oubliette and fight him again. Requires Nihil's Oubliette to be placed in the Orbiter. Victories against Nihil will consume the key and unlock one of his lost treasures.
Enter Nihil's Oubliette.Name: Enter Nihil's Oubliette

Patient Zero.Description: Find Alad V’s laboratory and put a stop to his madness.
Patient Zero.Name: Patient Zero

The New Strange.Description: Work with Cephalon Simaris to find the source of a mysterious voice.
The New Strange.Name: The New Strange
